AutoSpace 0.5.0-beta.15 is the fifteenth public beta — a prerelease, on the beta line.

## New features
- Dashboard, reworked again: amber is gone entirely — the ring-glow and highlights are warm white now — with a signal-red redline cap at the end of sliders and progress bars, and red back for errors. Blue legends, the two-level light mode, and the gauge ticks stay. Pick it in Settings, under Pairs.

## Improvements
- No improvements in this release.

## Bug fixes
- No bug fixes in this release.

## Maintenance
- No maintenance changes in this release.
